2. These Civil Appeals by leave granting order dated 12-12-2010 by this Division in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal Nos.1302-1305 of 2010 at the instance of the appellant has been directed against the judgment and order dated 12-4-2010 passed by the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka in Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal Nos.134, 139, 143 and 144 of 2009 allowing the appeals reversing the judgment and order dated 23-3-2009 passed by the Administrative Tribunal No.1, Dhaka in Administrative Tribunal Case Nos.I66 of 2007 and 22 of 2008, disallowing the case. 

 6. Upon hearing all the parties both the cases were dismissed by the judgment and order dated 23-3-2009. Being aggrieved with judgment and order dated 23-3-2009 the petitioners-appellants-respondents preferred Appeal Nos.134 of 2009, 139 of 2009, 143 of 2009 and 144 of 2009 before the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka. On conclusion of hearing both sides the Administrative Appellate Tribunal allowed the appeals setting aside the termination order of the respondents from service and also directed to reinstate them in their service with an-ear salary and other benefits by the impugned judgment and order dated 12-4-2010. 

 7. Feeling aggrieved with the judgment and order dated 12-4-2010 passed by the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka in Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal Nos.134, 139, 143 and 144 of 2009 the appellant filed the Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal Nos.1302-1305 of 2010 before this Division. After hearing the parties this Division was pleased to grant leave by order dated 12-12-2010 and hence these Civil Appeals. 

 11. We have considered the submissions of the learned advocates for the both sides, perused the judgment and order dated 12-4-2010 passed by the Administ: itive Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka in Appeal Nos.134, 139, 143 and 144 of 2009 and the judgment and order dated 23-3-2009 passed by the Administrative Tribunal No.1, Dhaka in Administrative Tribunal Case Nos.166 of 2007 and 22 of 2008 and the materials on record. 

 The judgment and order dated 12-4-2010 passed by the Administrative Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka in Appeal Nos.134, 139, 143 and 144 of 2009 are hereby set-aside.
